request.description:
Retrieve a paginated list of calls across your whole company, including calls logged on
projects, opportunities and accounts. Each call has `projectId`, `opportunityId` or
`accountId` set to the record it's logged on (all three are `null` for calls not yet
linked to a record).

Supports:
- Pagination (`page_size`, `page`)
- Date filtering (`updated_after`, `updated_before`)
- Filtering by `outcome`, `reason` and `disposition`
- Sorting by creation time (`order_by`, newest first by default)
